ideas.title: FBI's Georgia Election Investigation: What You Need to Know
ideas.description: This story would investigate the details of the FBI's investigation into the 2020 election in Fulton County, Georgia.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would focus on the potential irregularities uncovered and their impact on the election results.
questions: How will this investigation impact the integrity of the 2020 election results?
ideas.insight: The investigation highlights the need for transparency and accountability in the electoral process.

ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the Medicaid fraud crackdown on patients and providers in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would focus on the concerns about access to healthcare for vulnerable populations.
questions: How will this crackdown impact access to healthcare for vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: The crackdown highlights the need for effective oversight and enforcement of Medicaid programs.
